name: Token control help
description: Help mode entries for the Token control plugin (help@1): the page, its tabs, the try-it panels and the settings tab.
author: Brett

entries.title: Token control
entries.text: Change any theme, style, layout, typography, density or sizing token, the active asset per slot, AmberX notes, to-dos, tasks and lists, and Plan Studio plans and orchestrator builds, from one place. The same commands work through the REST API, the MCP tools and the CLI.

entries.title: Tokens
entries.text: Every token of the picked set with its value now. Change one and it becomes an override in the axHub look, so every app takes it. Reset drops the override and the theme's own value comes back.

entries.title: Passes
entries.text: Veto passes: let every command run without axHub's veto for a while, e.g. 30 minutes (Everything, the default), or only token changes in one scope (theme, style, layout or all three). Brett approves each pass once; irreversible deletes still confirm unless the pass includes them. Every change made under a pass is logged and Undo puts them all back in one go.

entries.title: Pass
entries.text: Shows while a veto pass is on: what it covers (Everything, or the scope) and a live countdown, e.g. Everything: 29:41 left. Extend starts it again from now, Undo puts back every change made under it, Revoke ends it. It turns to a warning two minutes before it ends. When Claude or an agent asks for a pass, the request shows here with Approve and Deny.

entries.title: Veto passes
entries.text: The longest a pass may last (1 to 240 minutes; longer requests are cut to it) and the time zone used for "until 10:42 AM".

entries.title: Try it
entries.text: Build a command by picking the op and the target, fill the fields, and run it. The panel shows the same command as a REST call, an MCP tool call and a CLI line, so you can copy whichever you need.

entries.title: Docs
entries.text: Every target with its ops, fields, filters and verbs, generated from the control@1 schema, plus guides and examples for the API, MCP and CLI.

entries.title: Audit
entries.text: Every change made through Token control: who, why, what and when. Reads are not logged.

entries.title: Token set
entries.text: Which set of tokens to show: colour theme, style theme, layout, typography, density, sizing or the active asset per slot.

entries.title: Token value
entries.text: Type a new value and press Set. Numbers stay inside the token's range; colours take #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb() or hsl().

entries.title: Reset token
entries.text: Drops this token's override from the axHub look. Every app goes back to the active theme's own value.

entries.title: Run
entries.text: Sends the command to the console's control API. A delete answers with a confirm token first; press Run again with the token filled in to really delete.

entries.title: Copy
entries.text: Copies this form of the command (REST, MCP or CLI) to the clipboard.

entries.title: Token control settings
entries.text: Install and uninstall the plugin and see its checks. Uninstall keeps token overrides in the axHub look; reset them first if they should go.

entries.title: Token set
entries.text: Which set of tokens the table shows: colour theme, style, layout, typography, density, sizing, or the active asset per slot.

entries.title: Reset all
entries.text: Drops every override in the shown token set, so the theme's own values come back in every app.

entries.title: Target
entries.text: What the command works on: a token set, AmberX notes and lists, Plan Studio plans, orchestrator builds, or veto passes.

entries.title: Op
entries.text: What to do: list, get, set, reset, add, remove or act (run a verb such as done or step).

entries.title: Value (JSON or text)
entries.text: The value to set, or the new record to add. JSON is read as JSON; anything else is sent as plain text.

entries.title: Input (JSON)
entries.text: What the verb needs, for act: for example {"list": "groceries"} for move, or {"minutes": 30} for a pass grant.

entries.title: Filters (JSON)
entries.text: Filters for list, for example {"kind": "todo", "status": "not-done"}.

entries.title: Confirm token
entries.text: Deletes run on the second call only: the first answers with this token; paste it here and run again within 10 minutes.

entries.title: Reason (audited)
entries.text: Why you are making the change. It is kept in the audit log with your name.

entries.title: Try it
entries.text: Opens this example in the Try it panel, where you can change it and run it.

entries.title: Extend
entries.text: Starts the pass again from now for its full length, so commands keep skipping the veto. From your own console session it is on at once.

entries.title: Revoke
entries.text: Ends the pass now (or withdraws a waiting request): commands in its scope go through the veto again.

entries.title: Reason
entries.text: Why you want the pass. It shows on the request and in the log.

entries.title: Start pass
entries.text: Starts a veto pass for the picked scope (Everything by default) and minutes. From your own console session it is on at once; from anywhere else it waits for your approval.

entries.title: Include irreversible deletes
entries.text: Only with Everything: hard deletes nothing can bring back (AmberX notes, to-dos and lists; tools axHub marks irreversible) also skip the confirm while the pass is on. Off by default.

entries.title: Longest pass (minutes)
entries.text: The longest a veto pass may last, 1 to 240 minutes. A longer request is cut to this.

entries.title: Time zone
entries.text: The time zone the plain answers use, such as "until 10:42 AM". Default America/New_York.

steps.say: This page changes any token, AmberX note or planner item. Tokens shows every token with its value now.
Try it builds a command and shows it as an API call, an MCP tool call and a CLI line.
Docs lists every target with its fields and verbs, with examples.
